authority.derivativePolicy: Locked PNG frames are reproducible derivatives. The MOV SHA plus decoded frame index and PTS remain authoritative.

coordinateSpaces.pixelConvention: Half-open rectangle enclosing every selected source pixel; width and height include the final selected raster coordinate.

methodPolicy.noManualBoxes: No output rectangle is hand-entered. Pixel methods derive boxes from fixed segmentation rules; source-semantic-mask methods derive boxes from hash-locked SVG classifications tied to the exact recording frame.
methodPolicy.featureStatus: Every landmark, route, boundary, copy, field-profile, contact-center, and composition feature is explicitly observed, blocked, or not-applicable. Each state names the directly visible landmark, route, boundary, field profile, or composition as its primary structure, so a scene-, field-, route-, or transition-primary frame is not failed for lacking an isolatable destination silhouette.
methodPolicy.chroma: Color methods threshold raw 8-bit sRGB pixels, find 8-connected components, and either union every qualifying component or select the largest qualifying component.
methodPolicy.edges: The arrow method computes luma with Rec. 709 coefficients, applies a 3x3 Sobel L1 magnitude threshold, dilates only for component association, and reports the bounds of original (non-dilated) edge pixels.
methodPolicy.boundary: The journey-exit boundary is the dominant horizontal row discontinuity. It must satisfy minimum color delta, row support, peak dominance, local column support, and vertical-variance gates.
methodPolicy.semanticMasks: A semantic mask is permitted only for a complete visible subject that deterministic chroma/edge isolation under-reports. Its manifest locks the recording SHA, frame PNG SHA, SVG SHA, raster, alpha threshold, support gate, inclusion/exclusion rules, uncertainty, and review status. Partial, clipped, effect-only, or disconnected aggregate subjects remain blocked.
methodPolicy.routeGeometry: Every observed route core reports deterministic PCA direction, selected-core endpoints, principal span, and equivalent selected-core thickness. These describe thresholded visible route pixels only; they never infer clipped continuation, a glow envelope, or a single-rail width from a parallel/branched union.
methodPolicy.copyInk: Observed copy bounds enclose selected visible ink, not an inferred DOM container. Fixed source-state ROIs exclude the header; a dark-neutral predicate and glyph-scale component area, dimensions, and fill gates reject large scene geometry. Faded or header-overlapped copy remains blocked rather than borrowing a box from another frame.
methodPolicy.fieldTileProfile: Applicable field states report a shared bright-neutral predicate, component-shape gates, visible tile-top count, field envelope, component centroid, median tile-top size, and mask support. Clipped, activated, recolored, or bloom-obscured tiles are never inferred; changes in surviving neutral components remain part of the observed reaction profile.
methodPolicy.fieldContactCenter: The field-contact state independently reports the largest saturated blue/violet center-tile component through the same source/implementation predicate. It locates contact without substituting for the source-tied tile-plus-standing-figure semantic landmark union.
methodPolicy.screenComposition: Every state reports a fixed-grid binary Sobel edge-support distribution, density, and centroid below the header band. These are screen-space composition and negative-space proxies; the 3D camera position/quaternion remain explicitly unknown and are never reconstructed from rendered pixels.
methodPolicy.quality: An applicable feature is blocked when selected support misses its fixed gate or semantic isolation would substitute a partial/effect-only feature. Not-applicable is reserved for a feature that is not the state’s source-visible structural role.
methodPolicy.reproducibility: The authoritative MOV SHA, every input PNG SHA, and every referenced semantic SVG SHA are verified before measurement. --check recomputes both generated evidence files and fails on byte drift.
